Some Jewish witnesses testified, and only Hans Frank, the Governor General of Poland, acknowledged the persecution of Jews.

programme.title: World War II: The Real Mighty Eighth
programme.desc: Discover the origins, and pioneers, of the Mighty Eighth and follow its birth and growth as it rises from the furnace of global conflict. As the world is plunged into war, for the second time in 20 years, the 8th Air Force carries out its first audacious missions against the Axis powers.

programme.title: Blood Money - Inside the Soviet Economy
programme.desc: By 1942, Soviet industry-rebuilt in the east-fueled the Red Army with mass-produced tanks, planes, and weapons, reversing the tide at Stalingrad. But while the war economy thrived, civilians starved under famine and rationing. With Allied aid and relentless sacrifice, the USSR rose as an industrial giant-at a staggering human cost.

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: Last in the deeply moving series about the Holocaust. While the hunt to find surviving Nazis continues today, efforts are being made to preserve the memory of their tragic victims.

programme.title: Hitler's Eastern Front: Army Group South
programme.desc: As Adolph Hitler prepared his armies for the invasion of Russia in 1941, he was conscious that he was about to change European history. He did change it although not in a way that he neither the rest of the war torn World would have ever thought possible.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: This is the thrilling story of one of the most decorated companies in the Army, Company K, 18th Infantry Regiment known as 'The Bloody One'. K is ordered to lay siege to an entire German infantry battalion impregnably fortified on high ground. The heroism of Lt. Johnson and the fearless acts of every soldier in the company are portrayed in this stirring tribute to the rugged men of Company K.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was fought for the defense of democracy. Ten long years of vicious combat - including the Tet Offensive and bloodshed at Hue and Saigon - permanently embedded the Vietnam War in the American consciousness.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: Graphically shown here is the treatment given our wounded in battle. We see the care a man receives from medics all along the line; from the time the wounded soldier calls 'Medic' until he is released for duty. The Medical Corps is saving more lives than in any other time of combat. Lieutenant Colonel S. J. Newsom of San Diego, California tells the story in an interview with Captain Zimmerman.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: The Army Medical Corps

programme.title: War in the Pacific
programme.desc: The Navy copes with supply shortages.

programme.title: WWII In Color: US Army Air Forces
programme.desc: In the pacific, in Europe, and on the continents of Africa and Asia, every branch of the air services now forms close partnerships with the other branches of the armed forces. The roles of transport and supply must now be balanced with combat, and the Army Air Force focuses on protecting allied interests on land and across the oceans.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: This is the story of a young apple-cheeked Sergeant nick-named 'Ma' by his men because of his protective nature toward their scouting unit. It is also the tale of Pat Cassidy, a looter of watches and wine and a member of Horner's unit. How these two opposites combine their talents to single-handedly capture a German-held land mine control center, makes a spellbinding, action-packed episode.

programme.title: Nazi Concentration Camps
programme.desc: This film is the official documentary report compiled from over 80,000 feet of film shot by Allied military photographers in the German concentration camps immediately after liberation. The footage is a camp-by-camp record taken in order to provide lasting objective proof of the horrors the liberators witnessed. Some emphasis is also placed on the humanitarian work done in camps by the liberators.

programme.title: The Crimean War
programme.desc: The first program looks at the reasons behind the war, and why Britain allied itself against Imperial Russia.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: While Hitler faced frustrations on all fronts, and the Japanese were kept at bay by the Americans, despite heavy US casualties, the Allied leaders faced a new challenge. Although Churchill and Roosevelt had always been comfortable working together, the Russian leader Joseph Stalin had in the past been regarded more as a foe than a friend.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As winter gave way to spring the world watched and waited as the Allied forces prepared for Operation Overlord. Brave and daring, risking all, US General Dwight D Eisenhower took charge of the campaign to deliver the fight directly to Adolf Hitler.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Landing Craft - Establishing Beachead. Silent film.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: With the fall of Nazi Germany, the focus shifts to the Pacific, where Japan continues to resist fiercely. This episode covers the brutal island campaigns, kamikaze attacks, and the increasingly destructive U.S. bombing campaigns. Japan's refusal to surrender prompts the U.S. to deploy a new and terrifying weapon: the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was fought for the defense of democracy. Ten long years of vicious combat - including the Tet Offensive and bloodshed at Hue and Saigon - permanently embedded the Vietnam War in the American consciousness.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: Graphically shown here is the treatment given our wounded in battle. We see the care a man receives from medics all along the line; from the time the wounded soldier calls 'Medic' until he is released for duty. The Medical Corps is saving more lives than in any other time of combat. Lieutenant Colonel S. J. Newsom of San Diego, California tells the story in an interview with Captain Zimmerman.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: The Army Medical Corps

programme.title: D-Day: 100 Days for Freedom
programme.desc: From the hedgerows of Normandy to the liberation of Paris, this episode retraces the 100 critical days after D-Day. Witness the fierce battles, the resilience of soldiers, and the toll on civilians as the Allies push through German defenses, paving the way for Europe's liberation and altering the course of World War II.

programme.title: Inside Hitler's Killing Machine
programme.desc: It is a word that sends a chill down the spine: 'Ahnenerbe'. This was the name of the research institute set up to prove the scientific foundation of Nazi ideology. Driven by a scientific megalomania, the race for new discoveries led the institution to carry out countless acts of barbarism.

programme.title: Great Tank Battles
programme.desc: This first part of the series introduces the first tanks being deployed on the battlefields in northern France during the First World War and describes the devastating effect these steel monsters had on an infantry confronted with them for the very first time. It tracks the development, both technologically and strategically from the Fuller 1919 philosophy through the German attack on Poland.

programme.title: Nazi Concentration Camps
programme.desc: This film is the official documentary report compiled from over 80,000 feet of film shot by Allied military photographers in the German concentration camps immediately after liberation. The footage is a camp-by-camp record taken in order to provide lasting objective proof of the horrors the liberators witnessed. Some emphasis is also placed on the humanitarian work done in camps by the liberators.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: It took 'men of steel' to operate Sherman tanks. The crew of the tank dubbed 'Dehydrated Hell' is assigned to act as a decoy to lure the elusive German 6th Panzer Division into the open. What happens to them as the Panzers close in and their efforts to stay alive until back-up arrives, ends in an exciting climax as the crew, under command of Lt Morrison proves they are true 'men of steel'.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Leningrad, a vital and large Baltic sea port, is facing the entire weight of Army Group North. The Soviets have no reserves to spare as the Battle of Moscow is about to begin. Wilhelm von Leeb's Army Group North fails to take Leningrad, but begins a horrible siege that will last 872 days, in which over a million civilians will die of starvation and disease.

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: Last in the deeply moving series about the Holocaust. While the hunt to find surviving Nazis continues today, efforts are being made to preserve the memory of their tragic victims.

programme.title: Visions of War: Infantry Weapons and Tactics
programme.desc: A historical record of the 281 days of the 3rd army offensive through France, Belgium and Germany, with air support from the 19th tactical air command.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In '1940,' we follow Hitler's trail of occupation into Denmark and Norway, the invasion of Belgium and France & the Miracle Of Dunkirk where Churchill initiated Operation Dynamo to rescue the thousands of BEF that were stranded & helpless on the beaches under relentless Nazi attack. See how Hitler's Blitzkrieg ripped through France and how the British survive The Blitz & win the Battle Of Britain.

programme.title: WWII In Color: US Army Air Forces
programme.desc: In the pacific, in Europe, and on the continents of Africa and Asia, every branch of the air services now forms close partnerships with the other branches of the armed forces. The roles of transport and supply must now be balanced with combat, and the Army Air Force focuses on protecting allied interests on land and across the oceans.

programme.title: The Crimean War
programme.desc: The first program looks at the reasons behind the war, and why Britain allied itself against Imperial Russia.

programme.title: Blitzed: Nazis on Drugs
programme.desc: In 1938 a drug called Pervitin was created in Nazi Germany. This drug was distributed to German soldiers during the course of WW2 and Hitler was no exception to these drug highs receiving drug cocktails from his personal physical Theodor Morell. This film explores the use of drugs in WW2 and looks at the potential effects that drugs could have had on Hitler, soldiers and the war itself.

programme.title: The Human Torpedoes Of WWII
programme.desc: See the history of the mysterious 'Human Torpedoes' of WWII -- and how they originated and developed upon the standard torpedo in top secret.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
programme.desc: The war really begins from the moment Saddam Hussein, the president of Iraq, launches his troops into Kuwait. These are spearheaded by 100,000 of his republican guard. Supported by helicopter gunships, armored personnel carriers, mobile artillery and tanks.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Victory on Cherbourg Peninsula - 'Allied troops complete the conquest of the Cherbourg peninsula as reinforcements are flown in by air. 26,000 German prisoners were taken by the allies who either captured or destroyed the greater part of their equipment.'
programme.sub-title: The Capture of the Cherbourg Peninsular

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: This is the story of a young apple-cheeked Sergeant nick-named 'Ma' by his men because of his protective nature toward their scouting unit. It is also the tale of Pat Cassidy, a looter of watches and wine and a member of Horner's unit. How these two opposites combine their talents to single-handedly capture a German-held land mine control center, makes a spellbinding, action-packed episode.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Meatloaf when done right can be a work of art, something worthy of the finest restaurant. It is all about technique and it is never hard to do right. Chef Stellino re-interprets for his viewers a fabulous Sicilian recipe from his youth and in the process he shares with them a series of foolproof techniques for getting done right every time.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Stuffed Meatloaf and Cake with Rum Sauce!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Cooking the perfect pork chop and preparing the ultimate sauce with port and Gorgonzola is a easy as 1-2-3! Making the perfect ricotta cheesecake is even easier. Chef Stellino loves to share his tips and techniques with a passionate delivery and easy to follow instructions.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Chops with Port & Gorgonzola Sauce and Ricotta Cheesecake

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Some call this the ultimate dinner, a perfectly cooked NY steak with a Vodka martini sauce! Chef Stellino once again shares all of his secrets in the making a an iconic sauce , the perfect accompaniment to the king of steaks: The New York. Then to sum it all up he shares with us a lusciously sweet, easy to make dessert of pears braised with Marsala!
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Ultimate Steak Dinner

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: A soup can be a form of art! Chef Stellino shares his secrets for the perfect soups, smooth , luscious and elegant. Plus he shows the viewers a series of simple techniques to create elegant topping to dress it all up. Simple clear instructions with step by step demonstrations on how to get it done in one try!
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Luscious Soups!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: A great dish does not have to be difficult to make in order to taste great! Fresh ingredients and simple techniques are at the core of these fabulously, delicious recipes. Chef Stellino guides the viewers along each step with humor and passion. He also shares his plating techniques that will help the viewers enhance the look of their finished dishes.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Grilled Shrimp with Peppers and Tuna with Tomato Salad

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Easy does it!, a delicious way to prepare a simple dish packed with flavor and panache, with easy to follow step by step instructions and plating directions. An old school recipe made simple for today's busy home chefs.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - A Delicious Chicken Dinner

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Nick prepares some of his favourite recipes including pasta with shrimp and zucchini, veal saltimbocca and cherry almond rice pudding.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Nick's Favorites

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Raichen's Rules: Seafood: Seventy percent of the earth is covered with water and yet, the combination of live fire and seafood can be a grillers worst nightmare. For this season's Raichlen's Rules, we've decided to ease your anxiety. A lot of people are intimidated by the prospect of grilling seafood, but by strategically picking the method, fire can make the bounty of the sea wondrous.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Raichlen's Rules: Seafood

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Game Day Grill: No one knows what spectators ate at the first Olympic games, held in ancient Greece in 776 BCE, but today's sports fans and grill fanatics like to celebrate their obsession with a barbecue. Tailgating favorites come hot off the grill in this episode as we tackle Project Fire Rib Wings, Buffalo Brisket Burnt Ends, and a Balkan Mixed Grill with some special guests.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Game Day Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Sandwiches Hit the Grill: It's a simple formula: bread + protein + condiment, but it adds up to a triple decker of pleasure. In today's show, the sandwich hits the grill. From a glorious BLT made with home cured and smoked bacon, to pan bagnat-a magisterial grilled tuna sandwich inspired by the French Cote d'Azur. And then it's a sandwich for dessert in a Project Fire mystery box.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Sandwiches Hit the Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Grill: Physicians have long extolled the virtues of the Mediterranean diet. Today the healthy foods and vibrant flavors of the Mediterranean hit the grill when Steven grills Sicilian grilled artichokes and branzino stuffed with fennel stalks. Then there's Greek grilled baby lamb chops with ember roasted potatoes prepared by friend and host of My Greek Table, Diane Kochilas.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - The Mediterranean Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Extreme Grilling: Steven has always enjoyed showing extreme grilling techniques that, though unconventional, deliver unabashedly delectable results, such as his Caveman T-bones or salmon on a shovel. Taking your grilling to the next level, that tradition continues with Lomo al Trapo with Fiery Colombian Salsa, Grilled Brussels Sprout Stalks with Curry Butter, and a Project Fire Mystery box.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Extreme Grilling

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Barbecue Takes Flight: What's America's most popular meat? It's Poultry. Americans consume more than 112 pounds per person each year. Today Steven prepares an astonishing array of grilled poultry from brandy brined rotisserie chicken to duck legs flame roasted Peking-style. And with a special guest a Project Fire first: turkey "ribs"-found in St. Louis, and virtually nowhere else.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Barbecue Takes Flight

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Skewering and spit-roasting meat rank among the world's oldest and most universal grilling methods. Forty thousand years ago, Neanderthals roasted hunks of meat over a campfire. Today, Steven spit roasts a pork loin stuffed with onions followed by an Indian rotisserie leg of lamb perfumed with saffron. He then skewers the unknown ingredient inside the Mystery Box.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Spits and Skewers

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: For many, barbecue means meat. But you may be surprised to learn that one of the earliest recorded barbecues featured fish wrapped in grape leaves. Today Steven begins with saffron-scented Catalan shrimp kebabs, followed by trout Mexican style with a sizzling garlic cilantro sauce. Then there's a Mystery Box that will astonish you as much as it surprised Steven.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Water Meets Fire

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques enjoyed many new food trends. But on a cold damp night, he still craves classic dishes like onion soup or for a family dinner or an elegant meal, a roast chicken. For him, these dishes will never go out of fashion, just like the apple galette he's been making for decades.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Some Classics

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Gathering with family and friends around the table or for a game of boules is the life's greatest pleasure for Jacques. He makes chicken wings, cucumber soup, merguez sausage, zucchini canapes, hummus and his father's Fromage Fort. Simple food that can be made ahead means that you can enjoy a glass of wine with your company.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Party Time

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: When the weather heats up it's time for family dishes that work on the grill or in the pan. Jacques' great summer menu with Asparagus in Butter Sauce, a Grilled Steak with Zucchini, topped with Anchovy Butter, Curly Dogs for the kids. He shows you classic ways to cut potatoes and ends with a Patriotic Raspberry and Blueberry Galette.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Summer Cookout

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques celebrates birthdays, anniversaries and holidays with special meals. It's when he splurges on caviar, oysters, even truffles-the ultimate extravagance. These occasions are a time to gather together around the table with family and friends and indulge in our favorite foods and wines.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Lavish Indulgences

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques doesn't always eat dessert at home, but when he does, it's usually some kind of seasonal fruit. Classics like Baked Apple Bon Femme, Bananas Flambe, Cherry Compote or Pears in Puff Pastry... are served often. A new favorite is a British Lemon Posset. Other simple staples are Blueberries with Lemon and Mint or Grapefruit with Apricot Sauce, all great ways to end a meal.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Fruit Deserts

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Rotisserie-smoked chicken with root vegetables; bourbon brown sugar pork loin; brisket; smoke-roasted pears.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - ABC's of Smoke

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: This show explores a region you don't normally associate with smoking: Asia. From Chinese char siu pork to smoky tangerine flan, learn to create a unique fusion of Asian barbecue and American wood smoke.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Asian Smoke

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Ribs epitomize barbecue, combining well-marbled, rich-tasting meat with the primal pleasure of eating with your bare hands. Embark on a rib world tour from St. Louis to Chinatown. Plus, learn how to build an onion bomb that explodes with flavor.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Raichlen on Ribs

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Find out how to apply classic ham curing and smoking techniques to anything, from spareribs to turkey legs, to create dishes that are anything but traditional. Plus, learn to make ham in a hurry and an eye-popping bacon dessert.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Ham Sessions

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Wake up to smoky breakfasts! Discover four smoky twists on bacon, hash, and more for a flavorful start.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Rise and Smoke: Breakfast Hits the Smoker

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Achieve great smoke flavor in 5-10 minutes! Learn quick smoking techniques for steak, cocktails, and more.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Smoke in a Hurry

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Barbecue originated in the Caribbean with a Taino Indian smoker-grill called a barbacoa. Explore barbecue's tropical roots with a tour of the Caribbean, from the French West Indies to Mexico.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Tropical Smoke

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Once you get the hang of smoking, you can smoke just about everything. Discover how to use electric smokers, pellet grills, ceramic cookers, and stovetop kettle smokers to add soulful smoke flavors to a spectacular four-course meal.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Smoked in Four Courses

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Everyone loves a cocktail party-especially when you infuse the menu with the intoxicating aroma of wood smoke. Check out these smokehouse recipes inspired by the world's diverse cuisines from Spain to Australia and exploding with unique flavors.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Smokehouse Cocktail Party

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The CentralTirgus is the biggest covered city food market in Europe. Just aside the Art Nouveau Old Town, we find century-old rye-bread making, grilled lampreys, soviet milk sausages, and hemp butter. Here the best of Latvian traditions are pushed fast-forward into the digital era by young and curious chefs, bloggers, and pop-up restaurants.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Riga

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The 'green' city of Germany has an incredible gothic cathedral with a food market at its feet. Every morning, six days a week, farmers from the Black Forest bring their trout and herb pestoes, wild berries, and smoked ham to the city. Be it a vegan wurst or a tasty cheesecake, here the surprises never finish!
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Freiburg

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The old ladies selling their baskets full of vegetables and cheese on the Dolac market in Zagreb bring us back in time. At the market, we go from the breathtaking Mediterranean islands to the Austrian Alps, from freshly caught hake and simple Baltic snacks to internationally awarded cheese and a unique Turkey breed.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Zagreb

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: At the Mercato Centrale in San Lorenzo, one can taste the best food treasures Tuscany has on offer: from the olive oil of the Fiesole hills to the onions of the medieval borough of Certaldo and up to the Natural Reserve of San Marcello with its Tuscan cured meats. Here the simple and genuine tastes are king.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Firenze

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The largest indoor market in Budapest is also the most elegant in Europe! Spanning over three levels, the impressive central food market is long recognized as a marvel. Whether it be the freshest fish, the richest goose liver, or the sweetest paprika that you're looking for, you'll find it. But don't forget the basement: this is where you will find the very best pickled cabbage in the country!
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Budapest

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Food markets have a strong tradition in the Netherlands and many citizens count on their long street markets for their fresh food supplies. One of the oldest and most famous markets of the Netherlands is the Albert Cuyp Markt, a street market stretching along the upcoming (and "hip") neighborhood of de Pijp.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Amsterdam

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Perhaps one of the most beautiful and well-organized food market buildings in Europe is the Mercado Central of Valencia. Built on the area where an open-air market stood for centuries, the Valencian style Art Noveau construction is a 'Cathederal of senses'.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Valencia

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: In this episode, we'll travel the BBQ trail from Venezuela to Peru, starting with a Venezuelan specialty-Asopao (seafood rice), reimagined here on the grill by Caracas-born chef Geronimo Lopez. And then a twist on two Peruvian delicacies-Tuna Anticuchos (kebabs) and Smoke-Roasted Peruvian Potato Salad.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - From Caracas to Lima

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Brazilians are world masters at the art of the rotisserie. In this show, learn to cook beef, chickenand pork with the proverbial turn. We start with Brazil's celebrated Picanha (fat cap sirloin)-served with farofa and Country-Style Salsa. Next, Brazilian Pork Loin grilled with Bacon and Prunes, and finally, Rio Chicken Rollatini. So put on some samba music and get ready to rock the grill.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - The Brazilian Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: The Caribbean occupies a special place in the annals of barbecue. Taino Indian barbacoa-seafood and meats smoke-roasted on a wooden platform that gave us the word "barbecue." The Caribbean remains a hotbed of barbecue delights; Jamaican Jerk Chicken, Trinidadian grilled vegetable dip called Choka and Shrimp Boka Dushi-a spicy Dutch West Indian kebab whose name literally means "happy mouth."
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Fire and Spice

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Texas BBQ to many means brisket, but in this show, you'll experience the Texas Trinity: Grilled Quail with Pear Salsa and Blue Cheese Farroto prepared by San Antonio master chef Jason Dady. Smoked and Grilled Rib-Eye Steaks accompanied by Smashed Potatoes. And a sizzling sandwich, a Hot Gut Hero (beef sausage with pepper Jack cheese). It's the Texas Trinity hot off the grill.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Texas Trinity

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Across Latin America, grilling styles vary: Argentine and Uruguayan masters embrace simplicity, seasoning steaks with just salt. In contrast, Mexican chefs layer bold flavors-marinating meats in recados and adobos, wrapping them in aromatic leaves, and searing over hardwood fires. Here are three spectacular Mexican grilling specialties that showcase this rich, fiery tradition.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: San Antonio is the home base for this season of Planet Barbecue. One of only two cities in the U.S. designated a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy, the Alamo City boasts a cuisine as colorful as its historic city center. Get ready for Carne Asado Breakfast Tacos, Jason Dady's Oak-Smoked Cherry-Glazed Ribs, and Beef Cheek Barbacoa prepared by local smoke master Esaul Ramos.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - San Antonio Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: When Columbus landed in what is now the Bahamas in 1492, he initiated an East-West culinary exchange that continues to this day. This show explores three European grill classics-each with a New World twist. From Wood-Grilled Gazpacho with Serrano Ham Crisps to a unique Pearl District Spiessbraten served with Jicama Salad. And for dessert? Spectacular Smoked, Torched Creme Brulée.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Grilling from Across the Pond

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: Matt Moore kicks off Serial Griller with "Hot Handhelds," grilling up bold favorites like Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwiches, Pork Gyros, char-grilled hot dogs, wings with blue cheese, and the juicy Hemingway Burger. No forks required!

programme.title: Serial Griller

programme.desc: Look inside this miracle of nature, in all its different and magical forms.

programme.title: Webs & Wings: Nature's Tiny Ballet

programme.sub-title: Battle to Save a Sea Lion

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue
programme.desc: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue center; find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

programme.desc: An anthology of stories helmed by more than two dozen directors details 26 ways to die, each corresponding to a different letter of the alphabet.

Initially reserved with each other, Oskar and Eli slowly form a close bond, but it soon becomes apparent that she is no ordinary young girl. Eventually, Eli shares her dark, macabre secret with Oskar, revealing her connection to a string of bloody local murders.

programme.title: The Signal
programme.desc: Mya (Anessa Ramsey) and Ben (Justin Welborn) are very much in love, but she cannot quite find the courage to leave her awful husband, Lewis (A.J. Bowen). However, when a mysterious transmission starts turning people, including Lewis, into murderous maniacs, the lovers must go on the run.

programme.title: XX
programme.desc: Filmmakers Jovanka Vuckovic, Annie Clark, Roxanne Benjamin and Karyn Kusama present four horrific tales of terror. In "The Box," a boy starts to display strange behavior after looking inside a mysterious gift box. In "The Birthday Party," a woman refuses to let an untimely death ruin her son's bash. In "Don't Fall," an innocent camping trip turns deadly, and in "Her Only Living Son," a mother must deal with the child from hell.

programme.desc: New to her stepmother role, Shirin moves into a duplex with her partner, Fredrik, and his son. The home feels like the right place to start becoming a family. However, when Fredrik leaves, strange things are heard from the other, uninhabited side.

programme.desc: A treasure hunter (Jackie Chan) and his team set out on a global quest to find a set of Chinese zodiac bronze heads that were stolen from a Beijing palace in the 19th century.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Firefighters Vince (Bill Paxton) and Don (William Sadler) venture into gang-infested territory to find gold that's been hidden inside an abandoned building. But when they witness a murder, they become the targets of crime lord King James (Ice-T) and his underling Savon (Ice Cube). Fortunately, the treasure hunters have kidnapped a bargaining chip: King James' half-brother, Lucky (Devoreaux White). But this might not be enough to get them -- and their gold -- out of the building intact.

programme.title: Smokin' Aces
programme.desc: Sleazy entertainer Buddy "Aces" Israel incurs the wrath of crime boss Primo Sparazza when he agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob. Two FBI agents have the difficult task of protecting him from a motley assortment of bounty hunters, hit men and nefarious vixens who are converging on his Lake Tahoe encampment to rub him out and collect a hefty reward.

programme.title: They Live
programme.desc: Nada (Roddy Piper), a wanderer without meaning in his life, discovers a pair of sunglasses capable of showing the world the way it truly is. As he walks the streets of Los Angeles, Nada notices that both the media and the government are comprised of subliminal messages meant to keep the population subdued, and that most of the social elite are skull-faced aliens bent on world domination. With this shocking discovery, Nada fights to free humanity from the mind-controlling aliens.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Captive State
programme.desc: After 10 years of extraterrestrial occupation, residents of Chicago must decide whether to continue to live under alien rule or support the resistance. When young Gabriel Drummond joins the insurgency, he soon finds himself under careful scrutiny from a shadowy figure who's trying to crush the rebellion and its plans for freedom.

programme.title: The Fourth Kind
programme.desc: Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler (Milla Jovovich), a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.

programme.title: Lone Survivor
programme.desc: In 2005 Afghanistan, Navy SEALs Marcus Luttrell (Mark Wahlberg), Michael Murphy (Taylor Kitsch), Danny Dietz (Emile Hirsch) and Matthew "Axe" Axelson (Ben Foster) deploy on a mission of surveillance and to take out Taliban leader Ahmad Shah. Though spotted by goatherds, Luttrell and his team decide not to kill them. But one of the Afghans alerts a group of Taliban fighters to the invaders, and a terrible battle ensues, in which the SEALs find themselves hopelessly outnumbered and outgunned.

programme.title: Jarhead 2: Field of Fire
programme.desc: Without tanks or air support, a corporal and his team must muster all the courage and firepower they can to fight their way across war-torn Afghanistan and shepherd an important anti-Taliban woman to safety.

programme.title: Walk of Shame
programme.desc: Meghan (Elizabeth Banks) is an aspiring news anchor in the cutthroat world of Los Angeles television. After an audition for her dream job ends in failure, she goes out for an uncharacteristic night of partying. The next morning, she awakes in a stranger's bed and hears a phone message from her agent telling her the job is hers if she can make it across town by 5:00 pm. Stranded in an unknown area without money, phone or transportation, she races to the most important interview of her life.

programme.title: American Pie
programme.desc: A riotous and raunchy exploration of the most eagerly anticipated -- and most humiliating -- rite of adulthood, known as losing one's virginity. In this hilarious lesson in life, love and libido, a group of friends, fed up with their well-deserved reputations as sexual no-hitters, decide to take action.

programme.title: Doomsday
programme.desc: When the first outbreak of the Reaper virus hit Scotland, Eden Sinclair was one of the last to escape containment and had to leave her mother behind. Twenty-five years later, Maj. Eden Sinclair (Rhona Mitra) leads a team back into the hot zone to find a counteragent to the virus, which has re-emerged in London. She and her comrades wage a desperate battle for survival against feral survivors, as they try to prevent it from ushering in a new dark age.

programme.title: The Purge: Anarchy
programme.desc: One night per year, the government sanctions a 12-hour period in which citizens can commit any crime they wish -- including murder -- without fear of punishment or imprisonment. Leo, a sergeant who lost his son, plans a vigilante mission of revenge during the mayhem. However, instead of a death-dealing avenger, he becomes the unexpected protector of four innocent strangers who desperately need his help if they are to survive the night.

programme.title: Dead Silence
programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.title: The Hitcher
programme.desc: Grace and Jim are a pair of college students on their way to spring break in a 1970 Oldsmobile. Blissfully unaware of the horror that awaits them, they offer a ride to hitchhiker John Ryder, a killer who subsequently terrorizes the couple and implicates them in a grisly slaying.

programme.title: The Darkness

Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

Thinking it's just a technical glitch, the friends carry on their conversation... until Blaire begins receiving messages from someone claiming to be Laura Barns, a classmate who killed herself exactly one year prior. As Blaire tries to expose Billie's identity, her friends are forced to confront their darkest secrets and lies.

programme.desc: After serving five years in prison for the murder of gang leader Donald's brother, Alfred, a fisherman by trade, finds that not only has his fiancée married into the mob but Donald is determined to ruin his life completely. A vendetta of mindless violence, which can only end in violent bloodshed.

programme.title: Monkey Fist Floating Snake
programme.desc: Chen Sing and Eddy Ko. The master of the monkey fist Koo Sze is on the run from Qing Snake fist warlord who wants to destroy his clan. He finds refuge in a small town where he becomes a barber and sparks up a friendship with a waiter who he teaches the monkey fist style in the hope that he can keep the style alive and safe from the Qing Snake fist clan.

programme.title: Fearless Golden Dragon
programme.desc: Corruption is rife in old-time China. Wang Yun rules with an Iron Fist. Enter the Fearless Golden Master and watch him liberate the town in an explosion of incredible and dynamic kung fu fighting. Raging kicks and fists!

programme.title: Mission for the Dragon
programme.desc: After a valuable antique is stolen; two sons (Dragon Lee and Carter Wong) swear to avenge their father's death and search of the last man to see him alive, but they are caught in a mystery of betrayal and murder. The brothers use their heads as well as their fists to find out why their father had to die.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru
programme.desc: Tako is robbed, Lord doesn't have enough money to pay for the hotel he is staying in, and Sengoku gets stuck assisting a cranky old man. Can the day get any worse?
programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 9

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: Itto and Daigoro arrived in Hida Takayama. Hikosaka, the local magistrate in charge of the village of Tsukada in Takayama, has been taxing the peasants more than the annual tribute and using them as laborers for his own personal use, which has become a problem.
programme.sub-title: Lone Wolf and Cub The Final: Episode 6

programme.title: Bruce - Kung Fu Girls
programme.desc: Five pretty girls go to Hong Kong to stay with their uncle who is a police superintendent. Soon they run into a gang of thieves, which gives them a chance to put their excellent kung fu skills to good use. This Bod Squad will kick your ass!

programme.title: Mars Villa aka Wu Tang Magic Kick
programme.desc: John Liu and Phillip Ko star. Mar Tien Liang is the master of the Magic Kick. When his home is attacked by the Fang Kang he effortlessly defeats his opponent, but his wife Mar Tien Liang is horrified to witness such violence. She implores him never to use his magic kick again, and all is well, until Fang arrives to challenge the master.

programme.title: Boxers of Loyalty and Righteousness aka Shogun Saints
programme.desc: Warlord Yu Ming gain great power for himself. Anyone he suspects of disloyalty was jailed or murdered. He himself was a notorious killer having personally betrayed his friend General Yip and then slaughtered him and his family. But the General' son escaped and spent a lifetime to learn all the martial arts to take his revenge. He must lure Yu Ming away from his private army of thugs and gangster. Shogun warriors come to the ruler's defense, though a few of them have second thoughts.

programme.title: Dark Lady of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Pearl Chang portrays the Butterfly Bandit, a Robin Hood figure who wears an outlandish winged costume who literally flies and crawls along ceilings.

programme.title: Warriors of Budo
programme.desc: Warriors of Budo Episode Four: Judo brings us to the modern era of martial arts when dutchman Anton Geesink shook the world by winning gold at the 1964 Tokyo Olympic Games, it was clear evidence that Japan's firm grip on Judo was broken. When Jigoro Kano turned the deadly Martial Art of Jujutsu into Judo, he created a global sport with competitors in more than two hundred countries. The Kodokan Judo institution is still however the symbolic beating heart of Judo.
programme.sub-title: Warriors of Budo Episode four: Judo

programme.title: Kung Fu Executioner
programme.desc: Li, a martial artist, returns home to find out that his father is being harassed by a crime syndicate. Together with an American kung fu champion, he vows revenge when the syndicate kills his father.

programme.title: Enter the Game of Death
programme.desc: Kung Fu idol Bruce Le, takes on the mantel of the late Bruce Lee and delivers a powerhouse performance in what many consider to be his best film to date. Loosely based on Lee's original concept, and filmed in the actual location Lee had originally intended to use, Le does battle with a whole array of opponents, including the nunchaku master, snake fist fighter, wing chun expert, and a master of the mystic art of Silat.

programme.title: Fearless Kung Fu Elements
programme.desc: According to Chinese legend, the Universe is made of five basic elements: gold, wood, water, fire and earth. These elements are also considered very powerful in kung fu. This film tells the story of five princesses and their loyalty to their clan as each must fight the demon fox using one of the five elements.

programme.title: Hell's Wind Staff
programme.desc: Kung fu super villain, Hwang Jang-Lee (known among fans as "Silver Fox,") is the main attraction in this brilliant kung fu flick, which was reportedly adapted from a comic book. Impudent but likeable kung fu students Tiger Wong (Meng Yuen Man) and Stone Dragon (Meng Hoi) have the potential to be great fighters but seem more interested in driving their teachers to distraction.

programme.title: Dragon Against Vampire
programme.desc: Terror from beyond the grave. Explicit sadistic sexuality. A fabric of perversion and witchcraft. Three friends rob a grave and evoke the wrath of a powerful practitioner of black magic, the Black Dragon, who is seeking the book of Shaolin Sorcery Martial Arts. Unknown to Tony, the surviving gang member, he has a magical power which, if given the right training, will overcome Black Dragon and his sadistic vampiric tendencies.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: Ittou and Daigoro were eating in a room of an inn in Ushiori when Okaayo jumped in. Upon closer inspection, there was blood on her hands. Okayo had stabbed and killed Bunbematsu, who had attacked her to take her body, by mistake after a struggle, and had entered Itto and the others' room to escape anyway. The brothel manager Torizo could not let her go. He ordered Itto, who was hiding Okayo, to hand her over to him. Ittou, however, refused to comply with his request.

programme.title: Bandits, Prostitutes and Silver
programme.desc: A carriage driver, Wang Tao, gets entangled with thieves when he wants to liberate a prostitute. Double dealing and lies befall them all.

programme.title: Mighty Four
programme.desc: During the Ming Dynasty, an honest, upright official is murdered by a greedy, jealous and powerful-hungry official, Ma. His son, Chi Liang, vows to someday get revenge and spends all his youth training in the martial arts. But in order to defeat Ma, Chi must master Magic Kicks technique with the help of the daughter of his father's best friend.

programme.title: 52 Masters
programme.desc: Will takes a class with martial artist Cole Rogers, who teaches self-defense for people with disabilities.

programme.title: Duel of the Tough
programme.desc: A buddhist priest and a martial arts student take on the powerful Dai-Kang gang when valuable scriptures containing secret kung fu techniques are stolen. Huang must learn the deadly technique of Magic Kicks from the Shaolin master and retrieve the missing texts at any cost.

programme.title: Ring of Death
programme.desc: Nui (Cliff Lok is very enjoyable in this role, and pulls it off convincingly) is a country bumpkin with strength in excess, but a childlike ignorance of the world. After leaving his aunt, who raised him, he seeks out his father in the next town, while there he is told that his father is a servant of a celebrated general.

programme.desc: Fernando traiciona a Don Julio y negocia con los Casillas, les da la ubicación de Zambrana a cambio de quedarse con el dinero de Rutila, Diana y Laura. La Felina sospecha que es una trampa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El ataque al rancho de Zambrana avanza a toda velocidad; Ismael se encarga de Aguirre. Don Julio libera a Tracy Lobo con la condición de que se convierta en su aliada para liquidar a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El detective Mejía organiza la cacería de Aurelio, en medio de confrontaciones armadas. Casillas muestra su amor y deseo de proteger a su familia, así como su faceta de mujeriego.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio resulta herido al salvar a su hija en el atentado, y él y Chacorta logran escapar en una de las camionetas. Escobar le pide a Casillas sacar a su familia de Colombia, pero él no le cumple lo prometido.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mejía captura a Casillas y lo sentencia a pagar por todo lo que ha hecho. Guadalupe le informa a Mónica que arrestaron a Aurelio; ella lo visita en prisión y le pide que se marchen juntos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Unos presos intentan asesinar a Aurelio, pero él se defiende. Explota una bomba en el carro en el que viajaban Ximena y sus hijos. Casillas sube a un helicóptero para su extradición.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas recibe una llamada de Ximena, quien le dice que tanto ella como los niños están bien. Aurelio es liberado y se reúne con su familia; decide casarse y establece una alianza con sus enemigos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Se lleva a cabo el matrimonio entre Ximena y Aurelio. El Norteño se da cuenta del atentado en contra de la novia, persigue al Jaibo y le informa a Casillas de sus sospechas sobre Mónica.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Isidro que sabe que fue él quien mandó poner la bomba en el auto donde viajaban Ximena y los niños. Mónica enfrenta a Casillas, despertando sospechas en su esposa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Guadalupe no cree que la muerte de su hermano Isidro fue un infarto: asegura que Aurelio está involucrado. Casillas les advierte a los suyos que se apoderará del negocio de los colombianos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice al Cabo que viajará con ellos a Colombia, pero Guadalupe y Mónica también llegan para acompañarlos. El coronel Jiménez da órdenes de vigilar a Mejía y a Eugenia, su novia periodista.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ahora que Zambrana sabe que Tracy Lobo es una agente de la DEA, acepta un trato en el que ambos se benefician; una invitación a La Felina acompañada de Casillas es el escenario perfecto.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Una llamada desde Belice pone a Mecha al descubierto, la DEA va tras ella, proteger a Casillas la convierte en cómplice y testigo para llegar hasta él. Colón pasa el dato justo a tiempo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se ofrece a ayudar a Lupe para rescatar a Mónica, pero él se niega, muy molesto. El Cabo le dice a Casillas que las cosas se complicaron: se preparan para el enfrentamiento.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dispara a Jairo y el Cabo lo remata. Casillas se deja seducir por la ardiente Mónica. Eugenia le dice a Linares que está preocupada por el artículo que escribió en el periódico.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Ximena que no se le ocurra hacerle algo al bebé que espera, ante sus reclamos. Compra un 727 para transportar la droga, mientras él y sus hombres viajan en otro avión por seguridad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo le pregunta a Aurelio quién es Letrudo, y se une a los planes para vengarse con Chacorta y el Turco. Víctor llega al estudio de grabación para ver cómo va Matilde con el tema del disco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La guerrilla retiene a Aurelio y Socorro, y él le pide a Chacorta que lo rescate cuando las negociaciones se complican. La Tijera le dice a Guadalupe que Casillas recuperó la droga.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Oscar obliga a Dobladillo a hablar por teléfono con Canica, quien le da la ubicación del comandante Macario, con quien debe de estar Aurelio. Mejía y Jiménez contactan a la agente Leonor Ballesteros.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le presenta a Mónica a la nueva piloto que contrató, pero ella la hace sentir incómoda. Ximena sorprende a su hijo Heriberto en una situación sospechosa con la tía Matilde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco le avisa al coronel Jiménez del nuevo cargamento que llega de Colombia, y le entrega la foto del Pombo para que sepa a quién deben arrestar, pero Leonor resulta herida en la operación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Roxana le pide dinero a Guadalupe, pero él la toma por la fuerza y se aprovecha de ella. Mónica indaga sobre los contactos de su hermano. El coronel Jiménez le cuenta a Doris sobre su ascenso.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Jiménez recibe un regalo especial. Chacorta llega a una colonia y hace un estudio para el expendio de la droga, habla con Aurelio y le dice que es una buena oportunidad de negocio en el país.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio tiene controlado todo el mercado del país con la venta en las colonias, y le pide a Irina que lo ponga en contacto con el presidente. Ella dice que con él no, pero sí con su primo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Marco Mejía le dice a Jiménez que deben desmantelar la red de distribución que tienen los Casillas en las colonias. Los Villalobos llaman para pedir una cita con Aurelio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mejía propone que Aurelio pierda su anonimato. Mónica está furiosa porque Casillas no le contesta el celular. Ponte le dice a Marco Mejía que ya tiene a sus hombres listos para la operación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Chapman ayudó a Juan a salir de la calle, ahora pide que le pague 67 mil dólares por daños y perjuicios. Yuly quiere emanciparse de su mamá y que además corra con sus gastos, porque la espía.
programme.sub-title: Cien años de perdón; Lucha por mi privacidad

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Deysi descubre que su esposo es el asesino de su hermano, a quien le sacaron los órganos. Tábata pierde su empleo como taxista porque tenía alergia y su pasajera la acusó de estar drogada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Javier necesita operarse y pide que Zuleika le pague lo que recaudó con un video donde él muestra sus genitales. Carlos dice que las dos hijas de su esposa lo acosan sexualmente y las denuncia.
programme.sub-title: Genitales en YouTube; Mamá bien me lo decía

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniel y Valeria pactaron no tener hijos, ella se embaraza y él la denuncia ante ICE para que la deporten. Félix quiere evitar que Stefany se suicide con su hijo, pero él no sabe la verdad.
programme.sub-title: Marido la vuelve loca; Matando a mis hijos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diambú es un reguetonero en ascenso, pero su esposa pone en riesgo el despegue de su carrera con sus celos. Alma le exige a Jesús que cumpla con el convenio que firmaron para criar a su hija.
programme.sub-title: La vida es de ella; Un hijo producto

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: John le muestra sus partes íntimas a su jefa en una campaña contra el cáncer de testículos, ella queda impactada. Además, una joven casi muere por la obsesión de su hermano con la seguridad.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrés nunca aceptó la homosexualidad de su hija Valentina. Ella optó por esconderla y salir del país con un supuesto novio. Desde entonces, el padre la ha mantenido, pero ha descubierto que su hija está casada con una mujer y quiere su dinero de vuelta. Michael quiere que su madre, Jessie, entregue a su nieta al sistema porque siente que ella no está apta para cuidarle.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Junior quiere que se reconozca la paternidad del hijo que tiene con Emily. Por otro lado, Marlon fue engañado por Paula, quien le hizo creer que lo amaba y que estaba siendo abusada.
programme.sub-title: Eso no es un papá; Todo por amor

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristian quiere ser el tutor de su madre inhabilitada porque su padre la maltrata. Odette adoptó a Claudia, la niña de su amiga, pero descubrió que en realidad es su verdadera hija.
programme.sub-title: Padre desgraciado; La deuda de la hija adoptiva

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Bárbara quiere la custodia de sus hijas, por eso refina su vocabulario. También, Alicia le tiende una trampa a su esposo en un crucero, él pierde el control y lo detienen, ahora será deportado.
programme.sub-title: Educación brutal; Trampa en el crucero

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El marido de Karla recibe una orden de deportación por culpa de Mirza, quien llamó a la policía porque ellos viven del gobierno. Leonel envía a la cárcel al esposo de Mariposa, su amante.
programme.sub-title: Odio latino; Metió preso a mi marido

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Omar va a Cuba y entrega una casa a cambio de su boda con Lorena, ahora quiere el divorcio. Luisa toma fotografías y videos de mujeres en baños públicos y luego los expone en galerías de arte.
programme.sub-title: De oveja a loba; Baño de mujeres

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Enrique tiene un comportamiento sexual con su nieta, aprovecha cuando la carga en su silla de ruedas. Adriana anda completamente desnuda dentro de su propiedad y Sandor la odia por eso.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diana y Darío se enfrentan a una decisión de vida o muerte, la gestación de sus gemelos: uno de ellos tiene problemas cardíacos y su vida corre peligro, pero una intervención quirúrgica podría afectar al otro bebé. Óscar, deseoso de ser un político, se postuló a concejal; pero Yalissa declaró que fue víctima de abusos continuados por parte de Óscar, quien le ofreció plata para que no dijera nada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Quiere vender su casa, pero no obtiene el precio que pide por la influencia de su vecina neonazi. Su hermano pequeño va a un colegio religioso donde el rector es el sacerdote que abusó de él.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nora y Daniel tuvieron relaciones, ella estaba borracha y dice que él la violó, pero él argumenta que la confundió con la joven con la que tenía una cita. Tika quiere convertirse en gato.
programme.sub-title: Abusada por error; Quiero ser gato

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carolina se reencuentra con su hija y su esposo, después de tres años, y descubre que la niña vive aislada del mundo. Felicia demanda a su marido por seguir un método japonés para ser feliz.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Juan está convencido de que es una mujer, su esposa, Liscar, le exige que vaya a terapia. Ariana tiene muchas cucarachas en su casa y como su amiga Claudia les tiene miedo, la demanda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alegnis se arrepintió después de haberse sometido a 10 cirugías estéticas para convertirse en la copia de la exesposa de su marido. Carolina causó un accidente mortal con una patineta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Rafael no puede acercarse a su hija, pero viola la restricción para salvarle la vida. Yerandys le hace sexo oral a sus clientas para librarlas de un espíritu maligno, Jacky se niega a pagarle.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Trajo a su hijo a vivir con él, ahora el chico sufre las torturas del padre, quien no acepta su orientación sexual. Cayó en depresión por la infidelidad de su esposo y la dan por muerta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Iván y Mery murió. La madre siente una especial conexión con el búho del niño, el padre quiere que se deshaga de él. Alejandro exige el divorcio porque le practican acupuntura anal.
programme.sub-title: El mensaje del búho; Acupuntura anal

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Se excita al escuchar a la gente mientras hacen el amor, hasta que fue su esposa quien gritó de placer. Tania está en su auto con un stripper, su esposo la descubre y se produce un accidente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Atropella a un cerdo en la calle y lo cocina, Dayamit dice que era su mascota. Livi escapó con su dote de 60 mil dólares, la madre quiere que la devuelva si no se casa, pero ella ya la usó.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Culpa a su hermano por su depresión, pero él alega que es ella quien lo obliga a verla y tocarla. La pica un insecto mientras su suegra se hacía un despojo con ramas, ahora quiere desalojarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Asegura que a su papá lo deportaron por una pelea provocada, pero al parecer el señor es de cuidado. Dice que el amante de su esposa ha sido una bendición, quiere que viva con ellos.
programme.sub-title: Asilo político; Viviendo con el amante

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nelly deja los hábitos, siendo monja, para casarse con Lupita, pero vive un infierno y quiere el divorcio. Enilda demanda a René, durante un incendio él salva los carros y abandona a la abuela.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marco exige 20 mil dólares a Karen por grabar y subir a las redes el ataque homofóbico del que fue víctima su hermana. Rhina pide una indemnización, sus hijos ven pornografía por culpa de Rubí.
programme.sub-title: Intolerancia gay; Pervirtiendo a mis niños

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Néstor es un transexual que habla y se viste como la Dra. Polo. Además, Osni y Edith, quienes compran "storages" y venden los productos que encuentran, discuten por un radio viejo con una nota.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Isidro maneja sus finanzas solo con dinero en efectivo y al perder sus ahorros, demanda a su pareja. Mercedes enseña ciencias con experimentos prácticos, una estudiante se quema con hielo.
programme.sub-title: El regalo de Santa; Experimento en clases

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Antonio le exige a su ex, quien lo golpeó en los genitales, que pague los gastos médicos. Gabo quiere anular la paternidad del hijo que tiene con Valery, porque no lo concibió conscientemente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Zamira padece glaucoma y su esposo quiere que reciba atención médica, ella pide un tratamiento natural. Karina quiere el divorcio de Luz, cree que su saliva es sanadora y cura con la lengua.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mónica le pide a Verónica, su ex, el dinero que le dio para invertir en su negocio, hay intereses ocultos. Alberto despierta del coma y no recuerda su boda con un transexual, quiere anularla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alfonso demanda a su esposa, ella se cree productora y quiere que los hijos sean grandes artistas. Exige orden de alejamiento contra la dueña de un restaurante donde dejó una mala opinión.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pedro quiere internar a su hermano en el manicomio por poner su vida en peligro para ganar un premio Darwin. Raquel pide el divorcio, su esposo enfrentará a su amante en un duelo medieval.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniel come un pez globo, muy venenoso y cae en coma, ahora demanda al restaurante donde lo consumió. Ambas son cantantes, pero Aylinne usa su trabajo para traficar droga, y acusan a Bella.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tony demanda a Carlos porque la esposa da a luz, inesperadamente, dentro de su food truck y causó daños. Fabio exige que su ex le dé 20 mil dólares, porque el bebé no es su hijo, sino su nieto.
programme.sub-title: Un nacimiento imprevisto; Persona de interés

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Claudia es evangélica y Jorge es amish, él quiere la custodia de su hijo para llevárselo. Jay Mula es un dominicano que rapea en inglés sin mucho éxito, pero se niega a cantar en español.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tebelio desaparece al viajar en balsa hacia Estados Unidos, lo dan por muerto, pero está vivo. Antonio le compra a María unas tierras en Colombia que resultaron ser de un capo de la droga.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Misael exige que Loreta le pague por haber matado a la serpiente que tenía como mascota. Susan es una maestra con novedosos métodos, la expulsan y pide que la escuela le pague lo que le debe.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Anabel exige compensación por desempleo, su jefe la despidió por negarse a trabajar con una prótesis que remarca su vagina. Brenda quiere que su hija se divorcie y el desalojo de su yerno.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mariela quiere recuperar la custodia de su hija, pero Criss, el padre de la niña, se niega. Por otro lado, Mabel conoce a un chico haitiano con una historia de vida complicada, él la engaña.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play a slide game before watching Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm. Then their mum cooks them for their tea. In Teletubbyland, the Lion and Bear play their hide and seek game.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep. Laa-Laa wants to sing a lovely song, but Tinky Winky is crunching his Tubby Toast too loudly!

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies march up and down a hill and then they watch some children explore the colour pink. Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Laa-Laa dances with her ball. A little boy tells us why he likes to live in his block of flats. A balloon appears in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies follow a balloon.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies giggle as they play their 'Through the Arch' game. The windmill stops them to watch a little girl and her dad go for a walk in the town.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf. The Teletubbies play a game to see who can eat their Tubby Custard the slowest, but Po can't wait and eats her Tubby Custard very fast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the Naughty Pig. Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa run into Home Hill to say 'Eh-oh', but where 's Po? Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing 'Handy Hands'.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes. In Teletubbyland, something happens to Dipsy's hat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: It's time for the Teletubbies to do their exercises. A voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch up and down to it's instructions.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two. Dipsy and Laa-Laa are eating Tubby Toast. They play the game 'Two Little Teletubbies', but while they are playing the Noo-Noo tidies up their Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are eating Tubby Toast. They stop to watch Amy making pasta. A ball of string appears in Teletubbyland. Po knocks the string in to the air with her scooter and it makes a stringy mess all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies play walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Samira and her friends show the Teletubbies their gymnastic routines. The Teletubbies do their own gymnastics.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song. Then, the Tubby Custard machine works again.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and the Teletubbies dance, before watching two girls do some Flamenco dancing with their teacher. It's time for the Teletubbies to wash their feet. They love using their Tubby Sponges.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little boy peel and mash some eggs for an egg mayonnaise sandwich. The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance around the trees and watch some children drum with their friend Norris. Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies. They watch some children make fantastic animals from papermache.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo. Tinky Winky sits down to eat some Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky says "Eh-oh". The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be the Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty hat. The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po. He looks for her everywhere, but she is hiding from him. When he finds her all the Tubbies dance a happy dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance an up and down dance. They watch some children painting pictures and patterns on to eggs. In Teletubbyland, Laa-Laa dances with her ball until the magical tree appears.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard. Po wants some too. She tries to eat the other's Tubby Custard, but they won't let her.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch a little boy show us how to make a Turban. The Tubbies go for a walk, but Po, Laa-Laa and Dipsy want to play with their favourite things.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and teaches the Teletubbies a nursery rhyme. Then they watch Becky go for a ride on a Tram. Po rides her scooter too fast and knocks the other Tubbies over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park. Laa-Laa and Po love playing with the ball. While they play they sing a song about the ball.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies pop up from behind a hill to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty sausage. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po go for a walk, so Laa-Laa decides to dance a secret dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies want to go to sleep, but Tinky Winky finds Po already asleep in his bed. So he goes to look for somewhere else to sleep.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk. They count three trees and three flowers and Po follows behind counting too.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep when a voice trumpet appears singing the rhyme 'Frére Jacques'. The Teletubbies laugh and call "Again, again!"

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see a little girl and her brother who love salad. They go shopping in a market a market with their grandma to buy some salad to eat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle. In Teletubbyland, it is time for Tubby Toast, but where has Laa-Laa's toast gone?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue. In Teletubbyland Po is watching the blue sky when it begins to rain.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme. Po's present is a little frosty cloud that begins to snow. All the Teletubbies laugh as they play in the snow.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see some children visit a level crossing and watch a train pass by. The Teletubbies play their Ready, Steady, Go game.
